title: [Feature Request]: Authentication of gemini pro models using service account file on google cloud
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

All enterprise cloud projects use service account file keys to authenticate. Autogen llm configuration does not support the service account file keys at the moment, rather authenticates with api keys. Pleaase make this feature available.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Autogen assistant and Userproxy agents to support LLM configurations using service account files.

### Additional context

_No response_

linked_prs.title: Use Gemini without API key
linked_prs.body:
## Why are these changes needed?

Currently, Gemini can only be used with providing an API key. This feature enables using Gemini with the google default authentication mechanism. Service account credential key files are also supported. Setting the GOOGLE_APPLICTION_CREDENTIALS environment variable will also work:
```python
import os
os.environ["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"]="/key.json"
```
Alternatively, the google_application_credentials parameter can be added to the OAI_CONFIG_LIST.
```
[
    {
        "model": "gemini-pro",
        "api_type": "google",
        "google_application_credentials": "my-service-account-key.json",
        "project_id": "my-awesome-gcp-project-1234",
        "location": "europe-west3"
    }
]
```
Setting the compute location for Gemini can also be specified, when using it with service account key file or simply the google default auth mechanism (like with a personal Google Cloud account).
## Related issue number
Closes [#2508](https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/2508)
